categories.main_business_segments: Sinkang Industries specializes in stainless steel secondary processing, including cutting, slitting, surface treatments, mirror polishing, and stamping of stainless steel plates, coils, sheets, strips, tubes, and wires. The company also engages in metal structure manufacturing, metal wire products manufacturing, mechanical equipment manufacturing, and international trade related to these products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs mature steel processing technologies such as coil leveling, cutting, slitting, recoiling, and surface treatments including wet grinding and shot blasting. It has invested in precision leveling and cutting equipment, continuous wet grinding machines, and advanced automation to improve yield rates, reduce production losses, and enhance product quality. The company also focuses on energy-saving improvements and process automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sinkang serves a diverse range of downstream industries including manufacturing, transportation, construction, energy and infrastructure, food and beverage, medical, electronics, and environmental engineering. Its customer base is entirely domestic within Taiwan, spread across various provinces to increase market share and reduce credit risks.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with facilities and offices located in New Taipei (Xinzhuang), Taoyuan (Dayuan), Taichung, Tainan, and Kaohsiung. All sales are domestic with no foreign sales reported in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sinkang Industries operates in the midstream segment of the stainless steel industry, focusing on secondary processing of hot-rolled and cold-rolled stainless steel coils sourced from upstream manufacturers. It provides value-added processing and surface finishing services to downstream customers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous improvement of processing technologies, automation, and operational efficiency. R&D efforts focus on enhancing steel processing capabilities, equipment upgrades, surface defect inspection systems, and energy-saving measures. Strategic plans include product diversification, quality enhancement, and expanding midstream and downstream customer bases while pursuing sustainable development and carbon reduction goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of processed stainless steel products including plates, coils, sheets, strips, tubes, and wires. The company also earns income from providing processing services such as cutting, slitting, surface treatments, and polishing. All revenue is derived from product sales and related processing services within the domestic market.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from domestic stainless steel producers and importers, particularly from Mainland China and Indonesia, which benefit from cost advantages and expanded production capacity. Despite market oversupply and price pressures, Sinkang maintains a competitive position through mature technology, quality certifications (ISO 9001, ISO 14001), advanced equipment, and a diversified product line tailored to customer needs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sinkang reported operating revenue of approximately NTD 2.97 billion, a 3.7% increase from 2023, and achieved a net profit after tax of NTD 59.1 million compared to a loss in the prior year. The company’s total assets were about NTD 1.97 billion with equity of NTD 1.72 billion. The company targets sales volume growth to 43,500 metric tons in 2025 and continues to improve profitability through operational efficiencies and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sinkang emphasizes high-quality stainless steel processing with mature and advanced technologies, strict quality control, and diversified surface finishing options. The company leverages experienced personnel, comprehensive processing capabilities, and strong supplier networks to provide reliable, customized products that meet diverse customer requirements. Its commitment to environmental management, energy efficiency, and sustainable practices further differentiates it in the market.
